Adani Wilmar (Fortune Spices).note: Adani Wilmar operates Fortune Spices as an internal brand portfolio and has not been acquired.

Badshah Masala Private Limited.note: Dabur India Limited acquired a 51% majority stake in Badshah Masala Private Limited in a deal completed in January 2023.

Desai Foods Private Limited.note: Desai Foods Private Limited operates independently under the Desai Brothers group and has not been acquired.

Freshtech Foods Private Limited.note: Freshtech Foods Private Limited operates as an active independent startup manufacturing the Dhani Pure brand.

Global Premium Brands Pvt. Ltd..note: Global Premium Brands Pvt. Ltd. operates the Spice Story brand independently and has no recorded acquisition history.

JK Enterprise.note: JK Enterprise operates the JK Spices brand independently and has not been acquired.

Kinjin Food Private Limited.note: Kinjin Food Private Limited continues to independently manufacture and manage the Vandevi brand.

Madhusudan Masala Limited.note: Madhusudan Masala Limited trades as an independent entity managing the Double Hathi brand.

Masala Tokri Private Limited.note: Masala Tokri Private Limited operates as an independent gourmet spice business with no acquisition history.

Nilon's Enterprises Private Limited.note: Nilon's Enterprises Private Limited remains privately held by its founding family and institutional funds.

Patanjali Foods Limited.note: Patanjali Ayurved led a consortium that acquired Ruchi Soya Industries Limited via an insolvency process in 2019, which was subsequently renamed Patanjali Foods Limited in 2022.
